title: Item threads and Plan comments update live and show what is unread

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: only messages and room_messages are in the realtime publication, so a Plan comment appears only after a reload, and nothing tracks what a person has read. Fix: a thread_reads row per person per thread (last read message), and new thread messages broadcast from the database (realtime.broadcast_changes on private channels, Supabase's recommended pattern over Postgres Changes). About 0.3M realtime messages a month at 100 collaborators, inside the Pro quota.

thread_reads records each reader's last read; insert triggers on item_comments and space_plan_comments broadcast to private thread:<type>:<id> topics behind a realtime.messages policy; item threads show a New line, Plan comments arrive live in the drawer. Migration 20270346460000.
